name: Not Dead Yet

angles.text: Eralya and her sisters are Sentinels serving in Teldrassil. Harpies ambushed them near the Oracle Tree, showing the danger facing the bough.
As an Alliance adventurer in Teldrassil, you may need to carry urgent word to settlements like Dolanaar when field scouts are cut off and overwhelmed.

faq.answer: Eralya is a night elf messenger ambushed while carrying out a mission toward the Oracle Tree. Mortally wounded and coughing blood, she asks travelers to carry word of her unit's fate.
The Oracle Tree is an ancient landmark in Teldrassil's Oracle Glade. Eralya and her sisters were sent there with an urgent message, but harpies overwhelmed them along the way.
Harpies ambushed Eralya and her sisters in Teldrassil's boughs. The creatures overran the patrol and left Eralya mortally wounded.
faq.q: What happened to Eralya and her patrol?

faq.answer: Byancie is a contact in the night elf village of Dolanaar. Eralya asks you to bring her word of the harpy ambush and her patrol's plight.

Eralya's message is meant for Byancie in Dolanaar. The village is the primary night elf settlement on the road south of Shadowglen in Teldrassil. Byancie lives there and receives reports and coordinates local defense efforts.
faq.q: Where must Eralya's message be delivered?

faq.answer: Harpies separated or killed Eralya's fellow night elf sentinels during the attack. With no reinforcements in sight, Eralya feared none of her sisters had escaped.
faq.q: What happened to the other sisters on the mission?

sections.body: Eralya lies wounded in the wilderness of Teldrassil. Her patrol was ambushed while she and her sisters traveled toward the Oracle Tree. Harpies attacked and cut down the patrol. With her strength fading and no help coming, she entrusts passing travelers with carrying word back to safety.
sections.title: An Ambushed Patrol

sections.body: Eralya asks you to bring her report to Byancie in Dolanaar. Harpies in Teldrassil's great boughs have grown bolder and more aggressive. They threaten lone messengers and sentinels on the forest paths. Byancie's village needs to hear of the ambush at the Oracle Tree before more lives are lost.
sections.title: A Cry for Dolanaar

summary: In Teldrassil, Eralya needs word carried to Dolanaar. Mortally wounded after a patrol toward the Oracle Tree was overwhelmed by harpies, she asks travelers to tell Byancie what became of her sisters.
attribution: In-game quest text: Not Dead Yet
